title: Dataset realism changes the performance question
method: Synthetic p95 values at a fixed 100 requests/s. Relative reduction = (260−150)/260 = 42.3%. Dataset ratio = 10,000,000/100,000 = 100; no linear latency relationship is assumed.
alt: Dataset realism changes the performance question: Tiny dataset p95 90 ms, Representative p95 260 ms, Revised query p95 150 ms. Illustrative inputs.
